manifest.name: customer-erasure-log
manifest.description: One erased customer subject (backlog:d271d723, GDPR validazione B6): which contact or company was erased, why the titolare confirmed it, who decided and when, and what the erasure covered. Append-only accountability: rows are never updated or deleted, and a second erasure of the same subject replays the stored row. The row carries no personal data beyond the opaque subject id — no name, no email, no phone — so the registry itself never becomes a copy of what was erased.

migrations.name: create_customer_erasure_logs
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_erasure_logs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  subject_resource TEXT,
  subject_id TEXT,
  subject_owner TEXT CHECK(subject_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  subject_owner_package TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  erased_by_type TEXT CHECK(erased_by_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  erased_by_id TEXT,
  erased_at TEXT,
  via TEXT,
  summary TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_erasure_logs_subject_resource ON customer_erasure_logs(subject_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_erasure_logs_subject_id ON customer_erasure_logs(subject_id);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_customer_erasure_logs
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."customer_erasure_logs" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "subject_owner_package" TEXT,
  "reason" TEXT,
  "erased_by_type" TEXT CHECK("erased_by_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "erased_by_id" TEXT,
  "erased_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "via" TEXT,
  "summary" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "customer_erasure_logs_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."customer_erasure_logs"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "customer_erasure_logs_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."customer_erasure_logs"("subject_id");
